request: Rename the `watched` field of watchlist items to `seen` everywhere.

requests.title: Watchlist > navigates via the title link without toggling watched
requests.reason: The test's assertion read `store.items()[0].watched`, a field that no longer exists now that `WatchItem` and every item in `store.items()` carries `seen: boolean` instead of `watched: boolean` (the old assertion would not compile and would always fail). Updated it to `store.items()[0].seen`, exactly as the instruction directs assertions to be updated to `seen`. The behaviour being verified — clicking the title link must not change the item's status — is unchanged.

approvals.title: Watchlist > navigates via the title link without toggling watched
